release_notes:
911 Setup now handles PLATE batches. Tick PLATE batch in the checklist
window and the run is set up for plate instead of shape:

- The plate workbook and the PLATES scribe verification form go into each
  nest folder instead of the shapes versions.

- MIL SPEC comes out as N/A on carbon plate. The MOVE TICKET's own FERROUS
  flag decides - stainless, nickel alloys and aluminum keep their real
  spec. It never guesses off the material name.

- The scribe sheet's UNIQUE - TRACE column is filled from the TRACE/MIC
  column of the working forecast. If the forecast has no trace, the cell
  is left blank for you - it never writes N/A on a plate run.

The box resets to SHAPE every run on purpose, so a leftover tick can never
put plate paperwork on a shape batch.

Scripting Prep: type the shared PO values once. PO NO, LINE, PART REV,
STANDARD CLAUSES, SHIP TO and PROMISE DATE go in a block on the side of
PO Data and every line fills itself. A line that differs can be typed
over. SOPO becomes SOUTH PORTLAND, spelled the way Mie Trak wants it.

Difficulty Stamper: the blue DriveWorks DIFFICULT label now stays on the
part drawing. The packet cover still gets its stamp.

Fix: the Run Selected button shivered on some screens whenever tiles were
ticked. The glow now breathes without moving a pixel.
